assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NextSeq 500), mouse brain; 4 regions (cerebellum, cortex, SN, striatum)
sample_inclusion: n=4 animals per group for RNA-seq; all 4 regions dissected from each animal (S2.5.p1); a separate cohort of 5/group was used for histology only
primary_estimand: Effect of 12-week treadmill exercise in MPTP-induced PD mice: MPTP+EX vs MPTP, within each brain region (S3.2.p1, S3.3.p1, FIG3)
planned_contrasts: MPTP+EX vs MPTP per region (exercise effect in PD; S3.2.p1, FIG2B/D)
MPTP vs Saline per region (PD model effect; S3.2.p1, FIG2A/D)
Reversal sets in SN and striatum: genes significant in both contrasts with opposite direction (S3.3.p1, FIG3A/D): SN 155 down / 66 up after exercise; striatum 49 down / 185 up
repeated_measure_unit: animal (4 regions per animal); regions analyzed separately so each animal appears once per fit
paper_method: DESeq (v1.14.0), per region; DEG if FPKM > 1 and p < 0.05 (S2.7.p1)
